items.title: Add DONE-required validation config schema and normalization
items.context: Support validationProfiles.done or doneRequiredCommands while preserving ordinary validate.commands behavior; invalid required config must fail closed only for opted-in projects.

happy.desc: A project with doneRequiredCommands normalizes required command entries without changing ordinary validate.commands behavior.

edge.desc: A project without doneRequiredCommands remains valid and exposes no blocking DONE-required policy.

adversarial.desc: Malformed opted-in doneRequiredCommands fail closed with a precise configuration error rather than silently becoming advisory.

items.title: Implement DONE-required runner and evidence artifact
items.context: Execute required commands separately from ordinary validate, record bounded command receipts, headHash/materialHash/storyFilesHash, policy hash, command-set hash, output digest/tail, and status.

happy.desc: done_required_validate executes the configured required commands and writes done-required-evidence.json with PASS receipts, output digests, and bounded output tails.

edge.desc: A failing required command writes a FAIL artifact with command identity, exit code, digest/tail, and does not look like PASS evidence.

adversarial.desc: Root npm test cannot satisfy self-host full assurance unless a preceding same-material packages/main build receipt or equivalent build proof exists.

items.title: Consume DONE-required evidence in DONE oracle
items.context: Add a dedicated done-required-validation row that blocks self-host required policy on missing/failing/stale evidence and remains advisory for projects without policy.

happy.desc: DONE checklist renders a separate done-required-validation row that passes when fresh required evidence matches current material and policy.

edge.desc: Projects without a required DONE policy render an advisory/non-blocking row and do not block DONE solely for missing done-required evidence.

adversarial.desc: Self-host required policy blocks DONE on missing, failing, stale material, stale storyFilesHash, or changed command/policy evidence.

items.title: Register DONE-required gate facts in process-fact contract
items.context: Update process-fact registry, levels, and contract verifier so the new gate-consumed artifact is mechanically protected, not only described in prose.

items.title: Add regression smoke coverage for gate behavior
items.context: Cover configured validate pass but DONE-required fail, missing artifact, stale material/policy/command-set, stale or missing build receipt, and external project without policy advisory behavior.

items.title: Document DONE-required claim boundaries separately from self-host config
items.context: Split CHK-005: this item owns user-visible lifecycle/testing docs that distinguish ordinary validate, DONE-required full-suite proof, external project advisory defaults, and out-of-scope release/pre-push claims. It must not implement release_approve_push or .githooks/pre-push behavior.

items.title: Configure self-host DONE-required policy only
items.context: Configure Orchestrate/Lattice self-host policy to require the package build plus root full-suite command before DONE, or an equivalent same-material build receipt. User-visible lifecycle/testing claim boundaries are owned by CHK-007; this item must not implement release_approve_push or .githooks/pre-push behavior.

auditLog.reason: INIT reviewer found overlap with CHK-007; remove the broad mixed config/docs item and replace it with a narrower self-host config-only item.

auditLog.removedContext: Configure Orchestrate to require packages/main build plus root npm test or equivalent same-material build receipt before DONE, and document external project opt-in/advisory behavior.
